package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    String createdAt,
    String id,
    String email,
    String website,
    String birthday,
    String short
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (String) map.get("createdAt"),
            (String) map.get("id"),
            (String) map.get("email"),
            (String) map.get("website"),
            (String) map.get("birthday"),
            (String) map.get("short")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("createdAt", createdAt);
        map.put("id", id);
        map.put("email", email);
        map.put("website", website);
        map.put("birthday", birthday);
        map.put("short", short);
        return map;
    }
}
